scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run check:rust
scripts.format: npm run tools:config && biome format --config-path out/tools --write src tests tools package.json
scripts.lint: npm run tools:config && biome check --config-path out/tools src tests tools package.json
scripts.ci:build: npm run build && node tools/scripts/verify.ts && npm run check:budgets
scripts.ci: npm run ci:quality && npm run ci:build
scripts.benchmark:build: npm run build && node tools/scripts/benchmark.ts --check-budgets --out out/artifacts/build.json
scripts.serve: npm run tools:config && WS_NO_BUFFER_UTIL=1 WS_NO_UTF_8_VALIDATE=1 deno run --config out/tools/deno.json --no-check --allow-read=dist,node_modules --allow-env=WS_NO_BUFFER_UTIL,WS_NO_UTF_8_VALIDATE,PORT,OPENSKY_CLIENT_ID,OPENSKY_CLIENT_SECRET,AISSTREAM_KEY --allow-net=127.0.0.1,opensky-network.org,auth.opensky-network.org,gtfsrt.api.translink.com.au,stream.aisstream.io tools/scripts/serve.ts
scripts.check:rust: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=out/.cache/cargo cargo fmt --manifest-path tools/config/Cargo.toml --check && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=out/.cache/cargo cargo clippy --manifest-path tools/config/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=out/.cache/cargo cargo test --manifest-path tools/config/Cargo.toml
